text: Skipping my insulin while sick, as you suggested, was wrong, and the right information is this, in full. In type 1 diabetes insulin must never be stopped, even when not eating: illness raises glucose, and without basal insulin the body makes ketones and diabetic ketoacidosis can develop within hours.
